description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Indibedda, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District. (25/5514117)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, ownership details, property boundaries, and land registration procedures. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner information, property extents, and encumbrances - all falling squarely within the Land Gazettes classification for land and property-related matters.
